summary:
The Last Chance of Earth: The N-47 Mission
https://zhuchkkii.itch.io/last-chance-earth
Interactive sci-fi visual novel about the N-47 asteroid research mission. Features character customization, branching dialogue, and mission management. Playable prototype built on Ren'Py.
details:
The Last Chance of Earth: The N-47 Mission is an interactive sci-fi visual novel and mission simulator developed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. The game addresses the challenge of space mission design by allowing players to step into the role of a mission coordinator. Players must make critical decisions, manage limited resources (budget, mass, energy), and select equipment for a probe sent to investigate the N-47 asteroid. The game features a branching narrative, full character customization, and scientific dialogue based on real space exploration concepts.

We developed the game using the Ren'Py visual novel engine and Python. The creative assets, including character designs and environments, were created using digital art tools and generative AI, while the UI and code were custom-built. Our project is creative because it combines the storytelling of a visual novel with the strategic depth of a mission simulator, making complex engineering trade-offs accessible and engaging.
